capabilities.name: message-inject
capabilities.meaning: A message can be delivered into a running session. A host that can type text into a pane satisfies it too.

capabilities.name: delivery-receipt
capabilities.meaning: Horde can confirm that a delivered message reached the session, not only that it was sent.

capabilities.name: resume
capabilities.meaning: A stopped session can be started again by its id, with its conversation.

capabilities.name: report-hook
capabilities.meaning: The harness runs commands Horde gives it on its own events, so a session reports without being polled.

capabilities.name: name-at-spawn
capabilities.meaning: A session can be given its display name when it starts.

capabilities.name: model-select
capabilities.meaning: The model can be chosen when a session starts.

capabilities.name: provider-select
capabilities.meaning: The endpoint and credential of a provider other than the native one can be chosen when a session starts.

capabilities.name: session-id-preset
capabilities.meaning: A session can be started with an id Horde chose, so its id is known before it runs.

capabilities.name: session.remoteName
capabilities.meaning: Horde can set the name a remote or web view shows for a session, at birth and on a live session.
